method: Static research only. Hash-verified AFM/mapping text plus bounded CFF1 literal-prefix decoding, including fixed literal subroutine references. No outline rendering or general arithmetic/branch evaluation; no vendor executable, Rust/C++ library or replacement table is run/emitted. Unknown prefixes remain unknown.
comparisonPolicy: Text-face glyph names come from positively BSD-noticed PDFium names, with the frozen existing WinAnsi undefined-code mask used ONLY as an explicitly labelled comparison oracle. Symbol/Dingbats names use the permissively accompanied AFM built-in codes. This does not independently establish historical author inputs or settle mapping semantic policy.

permissionEvidence.afm: AFM-specific companion paragraph permits use/copy/distribution with or without modification, copyright retention, companion-file retention, prominent change notices and unchanged paragraph.
permissionEvidence.mappings: PDFium mapping source explicitly points to BSD-style LICENSE; full source and LICENSE retained.
permissionEvidence.glyphNames: Adobe AGL source carries its own complete BSD-style grant, conditions and disclaimer.

existingDataBasis.widths: Positive AFM-specific permission evidence plus complete 3584-slot reproduction witness under the explicit comparison encoding policy. Do not require a width replacement solely because permission evidence was previously missing.
existingDataBasis.glyphNames: The current 231 glyph-name entries have exact matching values in the independently BSD-permitted Adobe AGL input.
existingDataBasis.mappings: BSD-noticed implementations exist. Standard is exactly equal; WinAnsi and MacRoman compatibility differences are explicit below, not silently adopted replacements.
existingDataBasis.note: Supported technical existing-data evidence, not legal clearance; notice/provenance adoption and semantic-policy confirmation remain decisions.

existingParser.fontHelperCrate: pdfcraft-fonts: read-fonts 0.41.0 via its existing skrifa 0.44.0 dependency

appleRomanContext.scope: Historical semantic context only: the snapshot's own header is not an express redistribution grant. It documents the 1997 Omega canonical-decomposition update and 1998 euro update; no new licence conclusion is inferred.
